summary: Retested SafeSeed determinism fix targeting the temporal generators (timestamp, dateOnly) that previously used Date.now() as anchor. Verified /app/frontend/src/lib/safeCatalog.js now uses Date.UTC(2026,0,1) for both. Ran three preset x seed pairs twice each and compared preview-grid first-row cells + Output SHA-256.

issues: Output SHA-256 value has no data-testid (e.g. output-sha) — minor testability gap. Captured via label sibling text as workaround.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add data-testid="output-sha" to the Output SHA-256 code element in ExportPanel.jsx for easier deterministic assertions in future automated tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in safeCatalog.js is correct and minimal: both timestamp and dateOnly now anchor to Date.UTC(2026,0,1), removing the Date.now() non-determinism source.
Recommend adding a small unit test that seeds RNG with a fixed seed and asserts a known SHA-256 for one preset — would catch any future regression instantly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Determinism regression from iteration_6 is FIXED. All three test cases (payments-log/42, hr-employees/42, iot-sensors/7) produce byte-identical preview rows including temporal columns and identical Output SHA-256 across two consecutive Generate clicks. Iteration-6 regressions (routing, presets, schema editor, formats, downloads, Redactorium) were not re-exhaustively verified per main-agent instruction — only spot-check of the fix was requested.
rca of the issue: Iteration 6 RCA: timestamp/dateOnly gen functions used `Date.now()` as the anchor point for their random-in-window computation, so two invocations at different wall-clock times produced different outputs even with the same seeded RNG. Fix: replace `Date.now()` with the constant `Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1)` so the anchor becomes purely a function of code, not clock. Retest verified stable across runs and across all temporal fields.
